verdict.rationale: Loops documents API endpoints to create contacts (POST /contacts/create) and update them by email or userId (PUT /contacts/update), with Bearer-token auth, an OpenAPI spec and SDKs. Contact properties are implied only indirectly, through segments that update as properties change and per-contact variables like {contact.firstName}. Nothing in the pack shows suppressing or unsubscribing contacts via the API, or anything about production-scale behavior. missing for 10: documented suppression/unsubscribe endpoint, explicit custom-property schema/creation via API, rate limits or bulk/batch operations for production scale, independent hands-on corroboration.
